title: ElasticIT App Manifest
description: Declares an app's permissions, pages, database config, edge functions, vault secrets, credentials, runtime config, and post-deploy hooks for the ElasticIT portal shell.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in sidebar and admin UI

group.description: Groups permissions in the admin Roles page

key.description: Page slug — must match currentPage switch cases

permission.description: Permission key required to see this page

mode.description: proxy = own Supabase project or external API, schema = schema in client's Supabase

schema.description: Schema mode only: schema name (must start with app_)

migrations.description: Schema mode only: migrations to apply on publish

up.description: Path to .sql file inside the app package

tables.description: Schema mode only: tables this app expects to exist (for validation + RLS)

vault_keys.description: Names of vault secrets (keyed by role, e.g. client_id, client_secret, token_url for OAuth2)

edge_functions.description: Edge functions bundled with this app, auto-deployed by publish-app to the client's Supabase. Reference the source folder inside the .eitapp package via `entrypoint`.

name.description: Deployed function name — URL will be /functions/v1/{name}

entrypoint.description: Path to index.ts (or index.js) inside the .eitapp, e.g. 'supabase/functions/my-sync/index.ts'

verify_jwt.description: Whether Supabase's runtime should pre-verify JWTs. ElasticIT shells use Entra ES256 tokens so this must be false for functions called with shell auth.

import_map.description: Optional path to an import map inside the package

inherit_secrets.description: Names of edge-function secrets the shell already provides (e.g. CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY). Declared for documentation only.

vault_secrets.description: PostgreSQL Vault secrets the app needs. publish-app provisions them based on `source`. Secrets are used by pg_cron jobs, trigger functions, and things that run in the DB (not the app itself).

name.description: Vault secret name (preferred). `key` is kept for backward compatibility.

key.description: Legacy alias for `name`. Prefer `name` + `source` in new apps.

source.description: Where publish-app gets the value: service_role = project's service_role JWT; project_url = https://<ref>.supabase.co; literal = use the `value` field; admin-input = publish-app skips and admin fills via Vault Secrets admin UI.

credential_requirements.description: External API credentials the app needs. publish-app creates placeholder rows in the `credentials` table linked to this app. Admin fills in values via Admin > Credential Vault.

provider.description: Stable identifier for the vendor, e.g. 'rippling', 'stripe' — determines idempotency on re-upload.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in Credential Vault UI

metadata.description: Free-form metadata rendered as help text in the Credential Vault UI. Common fields: docs_url, base_url_hint, required_scopes.

config.description: Runtime config rows seeded into app_<slug>._config on publish. Use this for values that pg_cron trigger functions need (supabase_url, feature flags, etc.) since `ALTER DATABASE SET app.*` is denied on managed Supabase.

source.description: project_url = https://<ref>.supabase.co; literal = use `value`; admin-input = admin seeds via SQL later.

post_deploy_hooks.description: Actions publish-app runs after a successful upload (schema migrations, edge function deploy, vault provisioning, etc. all complete). Fire-and-forget via EdgeRuntime.waitUntil — publish-app returns immediately.

function.description: Name of the edge function to invoke (must match edge_functions[].name)

body.description: JSON body passed to the function

async.description: If true, invoke via EdgeRuntime.waitUntil (don't wait for response)

require_all_credentials_set.description: Skip this hook if any credential_requirements[] entry still has a placeholder credential row. Admin UI will trigger pending hooks after credentials are filled.

notifications.description: Email-alert event types this app emits that users can opt into on the portal Notifications page. Synced into app_notifications on publish. The full event_type fired to send-notification is `{slug}:{key}`. To explicitly opt out of email alerts, declare an empty array.

key.description: Snake_case event identifier within this app (e.g. sync_error). Combined with slug to form the full event_type as `{slug}:{key}`.

label.description: Short user-facing label shown next to the opt-in checkbox on the portal Notifications page.

description.description: One-sentence description of when this event fires, shown to users alongside the opt-in checkbox.

sort_order.description: Display order within this app's section of the Notifications page.
